candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to classify or segment individual leads against personas in a connected GTM context. Not for lead scoring, person research, persona authoring, account segmentation, or repository management.
candidates.rationale: Direct task noun and sibling exclusions.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to classify, segment, route, bucket, or qualify individual leads or contacts against personas in a connected GTM context. Not for scoring already-labeled leads, researching people, defining personas, segmenting companies, or managing the context repository.
candidates.rationale: Covers common segmentation verbs while making the labels-in scoring seam explicit.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user wants one persona segment or no-match assigned to each supplied person using a connected GTM context. Not for fit-band scoring, enrichment, lead research, persona creation, company segmentation, or context setup.
candidates.rationale: Describes the observable output and sharpens person-versus-company intent.
